description.value: Riverhaven RV Park and Motel sits on the banks of the Similkameen River at Hedley along Highway 3 (Crowsnest Pass), offering 22 full-service RV sites plus four motel rooms for those wanting an indoor stay. The park features a sandy beach, fishing, swimming, and fully shaded and grassed sites in a setting that repeat visitors from Canada, the US, and Europe describe as a tranquil hidden gem. It occupies a strategically useful position on a major BC interior touring corridor through the scenic Similkameen Valley.
